Fabraix focuses on building security for AI agents in two main areas:

1. **Automated Red-Teaming**: This involves an AI system that probes other AI agents to identify vulnerabilities and ways they can be manipulated or misused.
2. **Real-Time Guardrails**: This aspect monitors and validates an agent's actions, blocking any unsafe or malicious behavior in production.

You can learn more at [Fabraix's website](https://fabraix.com).
